finalizeReferendumVeto(bytes32).notice: Finalizes a referendum-veto vote after its deadline and cancels the referendum if threshold is met.

finalizeSubLegalMeasureRepeal(bytes32).notice: Finalizes a sub-legal repeal vote after its deadline and repeals the measure if threshold is met.

identityRegistry().notice: Returns the configured identity registry address used for holder and successor person resolution.
